exercises.starter_code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, left=None, right=None):
        self.value = value
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
root = Node('a', Node('b'), Node('c'))
order = []
def walk(node):
    if not node:
        return
    order.append(node.value)
    walk(node.left)
    walk(node.right)
walk(root)
print(''.join(order))

lessons.title: Practice BST Insert
lessons.description: Finish bst_insert. Insert values into a binary search tree. The test checks that bst_insert(root, v).value equals 5; bst_insert(root, v).left.value equals 3; bst_insert(root, v).right.value equals 7.
learning_objectives: Mesa crews recount crates before dawn, and maintain BST ordering on insert.

tests.name: test_bst_insert
tests.unittest_code:
def test_bst_insert(self):
    root = None
    for v in [5, 3, 7]:
        root = bst_insert(root, v)
    self.assertEqual(root.value, 5)
    self.assertEqual(root.left.value, 3)
    self.assertEqual(root.right.value, 7)

lessons.title: Practice BST Contains
lessons.description: BST search challenge: implement bst_contains(root, value). Start at the root; while the current node exists, compare value with cur.value — go right when value is larger, left when smaller, and return True on an exact match. Reaching a None child means the value is not in the tree. Tests: the tree 5(3, 7) contains 7 (True) but not 4 (False). The test checks that bst_contains(root, 7) is true; bst_contains(root, 4) is false.
learning_objectives: Orchard crews recount crates before dawn, and search left right based on comparison.

tests.name: test_bst_contains
tests.unittest_code:
def test_bst_contains(self):
    root = TreeNode(5, TreeNode(3), TreeNode(7))
    self.assertTrue(bst_contains(root, 7))
    self.assertFalse(bst_contains(root, 4))

lessons.title: Practice Tree Height
lessons.description: Return the height of a binary tree (empty tree height 0). The test checks that height(root) equals 3; height(None) equals 0.

def test_height(self):

lessons.title: Practice Unit 6 Checkpoint Trees BST
lessons.description: Finish is_bst. Validate whether a tree is a BST (strict: left < node < right for all nodes). The test checks that is_bst(good) is true; is_bst(bad) is false.
learning_objectives: Attic crews recount crates before dawn, and track allowed value ranges while recursing.

tests.name: test_is_bst
tests.unittest_code:
def test_is_bst(self):
    good = TreeNode(2, TreeNode(1), TreeNode(3))
    bad = TreeNode(2, TreeNode(3), TreeNode(1))
    self.assertTrue(is_bst(good))
    self.assertFalse(is_bst(bad))
